newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Chemists has offers for wholesaling.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Chemists has offers for wholesaling.

text.p: Pharmaceutical wholesalers and retailing group Lloyds Chemists Plc on Tuesday said it had received numerous offers from prospective purchasers of some of its wholesale businesses.
The company said the sales of the wholesaling units would only complete if either UniChem Plc or GEHE AG were successful in acquiring Lloyds Chemists.
"The Board has been particularly encouraged by the number of parties who have responded and the values which they have attributed to the businesses in question," the company said in a statement.
Lloyds Chemists said it had forwarded signed heads of terms to UniChem and GEHE to assist them in satisfying the conditions laid down by the UK Secretary of State.
Gehe's 620 million stg ($960.8 million) bid for Lloyds lapsed in March along with a similar rival by UniChem after the British government referred them to the UK's Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Last month the British government said bids by either UniChem or GEHE for Lloyds could go ahead if certain Lloyds assets were sold off.

LLoyds said it had been informed by the panel on Takeovers and Mergers that the 21 day period within which a party must announce any new offer will commence when the Secretary of State announces that the conditions laid down by him have been fulfilled by that party.
In the event that the Secretary of State makes separate announcements in respect of each of the parties, the period will expire 21 days after the second such announcement.
